# PWA check

The app installs and opens offline through four files that must agree. Open each one; do not rely on this list.

1. **Manifest** `public/manifest.webmanifest`: `name`/`short_name` match the app title (`VITE_APP_TITLE`, default "Chess"), `theme_color` and `background_color` match the `theme-color` meta in `index.html` (dark theme, `#212529`), `start_url` and `scope` are `/`, and every `icons[].src` points to a file in `public/icons/` (`icon-192.png` 192x192, `icon-512.png` 512x512, which also serves as the maskable icon).
2. **Page tags** `index.html`: `<link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.webmanifest" />`, `<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/icons/apple-touch-icon.png" />`, the `theme-color` and `apple-mobile-web-app-*` metas.
3. **Service worker** `public/sw.js`: every path in the `SHELL` array exists under `public/` (or is `/` or `/index.html`). If the list changed, or a cached file changed in a way users must refetch, bump `CACHE_NAME` (`chess-shell-v<N>`); the `activate` handler deletes older caches. The worker must keep ignoring non-GET requests and other origins: API answers are never cached.
4. **Registration and hosting**: `src/services/pwa.ts` registers `/sw.js` only when enabled (production), and `netlify.toml` keeps `Cache-Control: no-cache` for `/sw.js`. `public/_redirects` keeps the single-page fallback.

Also check the install button path: `src/domain/install.ts`, `src/composables/useInstallPrompt.ts` and `src/components/layout/InstallAppButton.vue`, with the texts under `install` in `src/i18n/messages/` (all six languages).

## Verify

- `npm run build`, then look at `dist/`: `manifest.webmanifest`, `sw.js` and `icons/` must be there, copied from `public/`.
- `npx vitest run tests/services/pwa.test.ts tests/domain/install.test.ts tests/composables/install-prompt.test.ts tests/components/install-app.test.ts`.
- If the user asks to see it in a browser: `npm run build`, `npm run preview`, open DevTools, Application tab, and check Manifest and Service Workers. Say so if you did not do this.

Report each of the four items as pass or fail with the file and the exact difference. A change to the manifest colours or icons is a look change: confirm with the user and update `docs/specs/frontend.md` section 4 (`CLAUDE.md`, Styling).
